summary: NIO Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its July 2026 delivery update under Rule 13a-16. The press release reports 35,934 vehicles delivered in July 2026, a 71.0% year-over-year increase, and 227,057 vehicles year-to-date, up 68.0%, with cumulative deliveries reaching 1,224,649. It also notes delivery milestones for the All-New ES8 and the launch of a five-seat version. This is a routine operational update by the issuer, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, restructuring, or capital return. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions are mentioned.
